en.summary: Parliament passed the 2027 budget on 29 September: Rp 4,106 trillion in spending and a deficit of 2.4% of GDP. The Prabowo government aims for 8% growth by 2029, built on free meals (MBG), food self-sufficiency and the Danantara fund. In 2027 it will focus on 10 programmes, including renovating 10,000 health centres, 100 GW of solar, a minerals and strategic commodities exchange, and support for one million electric motorcycles.
watch: Check the mandatory certification schedule and import rules under the Halal Product Assurance law
Rupiah volatility against the 2027 budget assumptions, and the 3%-of-GDP deficit cap, could force spending adjustments
Investigations are exposing corruption and operational risks in large national programs such as MBG
